about.title: Our Journey
about.content:
MiniWatch Store is your trusted destination for stylish, high-quality watches in Tanzania. We bring you a carefully selected collection of modern, classic, and sporty timepieces designed to match your lifestyle.

Our goal is simple — to offer affordable elegance without compromising on quality. Whether you're looking for an everyday watch or a statement piece, MiniWatch Store delivers reliability, style, and value in every product.

Based in Tanzania, we are committed to providing a smooth shopping experience, fast delivery, and excellent customer service.

policy.title: MiniWatch Store Policies
policy.content:
**1. Ordering & Payment**
We accept secure payments through trusted methods. Orders are processed only after payment confirmation. Please ensure your details are accurate before completing your purchase.

**2. Delivery**
We deliver across Tanzania. Orders are processed within 1–2 business days, and delivery times may vary depending on your location. We aim to get your order to you as quickly as possible.

**3. Returns & Exchanges**
If you receive a defective or incorrect item, you can request a return or exchange within 3 days of delivery. The item must be unused and in its original packaging.

**4. Refunds**
Refunds are issued only for approved returns. Once your item is received and inspected, your refund will be processed within a few business days.

**5. Product Quality**
We ensure all our watches meet quality standards. However, slight variations in color or design may occur due to lighting or display differences.

**6. Customer Responsibility**
Customers are responsible for providing accurate delivery information and being available to receive orders.

**7. Policy Updates**
MiniWatch Store reserves the right to update these policies at any time. Changes will be communicated clearly on our platform.
